Net nuclear charge felt by outer e-.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Across a period: nuclear charge rises but shielding ~constant, so outer e- pulled closer.

Down a group: more shells, outer e- further from nucleus, radius increases.

General rise from Na to Ar, but two dips: Al (3p starts, easier to remove) and S (3p4 has paired e- repelling).

Trend: Na < Mg > Al > Si < P > S < Cl < Ar in order of IE values.

Na, Mg, Al: metallic, mp increases with charge density. Si: giant covalent, very high mp.

P4, S8, Cl2, Ar: simple molecular, mp drops sharply; depends on London force size. S8 > P4 > Cl2 > Ar.
